headline: MSP Steel & Power submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from MSP Steel
summary: MSP Steel & Power Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The submission is a standard regulatory filing required by the stock exchanges. Retail investors can review the voting outcomes for corporate governance insights, though this does not immediately impact stock price or operations.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price
